newsitem.title: USA: Md. Gov proposes more funding for police -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Md. Gov proposes more funding for police -- paper.

text.p: Maryland Gov Parris Glendening proposed increasing state funding for police to add more troopers and raise salaries, the Washington Post reported Friday.
The proposal envisions spending $4.4 million annually to pay for an additional 225 state troopers, and $5.7 million annually for 10 percent salary increases.

The proposals were part of the governor's spending package the General Assembly will begin considering when it reconvenes on Wednesday. Glendening is also asking lawmakers to approve a 10 percent cut in personal income taxes.
